name: Flamewraith
body:
FLAMEWRAITH
CR 3

This misshapen entity’s body is composed of nearly transparent ghostly flames shot through with strange colors giving off a withering heat.

XP 800
NE Medium undead (fire, incorporeal)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10
Aura ghost flames (5 ft., DC 15)

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 17, flat-footed 12 (+2 deflection, +4 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 39 (6d8+12)
Fort +2, Ref +6, Will +6
Defensive Abilities incorporeal; Immune fire, undead traits
Weaknesses vulnerable to cold

OFFENSE

Speed fly 30 ft. (perfect)
Melee flame lash +8 (1d6+5 fire plus burn)
Ranged flame blast +13 (1d4+3 fire plus burn)
Special Attacks burn (1d4, DC 13), inferno

STATISTICS

Str —, Dex 19, Con —, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 15
Base Atk +4; CMB +8; CMD 18
Feats Dodge, Mobility
Skills Fly +17, Intimidate +11, Perception +10, Stealth +13
Languages Ignan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Flame Blast (Su)

A flamewraith’s flame blast has a range of 60 feet (no range increment).

Ghost Flames (Su)

A flamewraith is constantly surrounded by a nimbus of flickering, ghostly flames that deal 1d4 fire damage to adjacent creatures (Reflex DC 15 half). If a flamewraith takes any amount of cold damage, this aura is suppressed for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Inferno (Su)

As a full-round action, a flamewraith can expand and intensify its ghost flames aura. The flames blaze outward, dealing 1d6 fire damage to creatures in a 10-foot-radius burst centered on the flamewraith (Reflex DC 15 half). It can’t activate this ability again for 1d4 rounds, during which its ghost flames aura is suppressed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, blaze (3–6), or nova (7–25)
Treasure incidental

Flamewraiths are the fading remnants of fire elemental creatures whose life force has been drained, either by contact with the undead or at the planar vergence between the Elemental Planes of Fire and the Negative Energy Plane. They are birthed into the cosmos amid the fading flames of dying stars, cast out into the void by collapsing neutron stars or in the explosive aftershocks of nova and supernova explosions.
